name: ConsoleUI v1.0.2
body:
## New

- Melee swing timer, including linked main-hand and off-hand bars for dual wield.
- Segmented ranged timer for Draw, Shoot, and Cooldown. Interrupted draws flash red; fired shots flash white.
- Swing Timer HUD controls for size, offset, gap, color, labels, spark, and combat-only fade.

## Fixed

- Hunter shot icons now update their range color correctly.
- Rested XP no longer shows stale progress after leveling up.
- Copy From now restores action bars and Blizzard frame positions correctly.
- Minimap and buff/debuff placement persists through reloads, including scaled minimaps.
- XP, reputation, and swing-timer settings rows no longer overlap.
- Missing self-check files are included in the addon package.
- Reduced unnecessary HUD refresh work for smoother frame updates.

Install both `ConsoleUI` and `ConsoleUIKeyboard` folders. Fully quit WoW before replacing the folders.
